scenes.name: The Hook: The Struggle
scenes.description: Extreme close-up on an aggressively blinking cursor. Quick cuts between a stressed person staring at the blank screen and a calendar with overdue deadlines flashing red. Split screen reinforces internal vs. external pressure.
scenes.effects: Fast, jarring cuts. A low, tense hum in the background.
visualEffects: Bold red text overlay 'WRITER'S BLOCK?' flashes on screen for first 2 seconds.

scenes.name: The Reveal
scenes.description: The user quickly types 'AI writing assistant' into a search bar. The Jasper.ai homepage immediately pops up. A quick shot of the user's face shows a subtle 'aha!' moment of realization, their eyes widening just before the logo is prominent.
scenes.effects: Quick zoom into the search result. A bright, optimistic sound effect replaces the tense music.

scenes.name: The Transformation
scenes.description: A rapid, crystal-clear montage of the Jasper interface in action. We see a simple prompt generating multiple variations of content (3 ad headlines, 3 tweet ideas) in rapid succession. The hyper-lapse briefly pauses for 1 second on a high-quality, human-sounding snippet of text, zooming in slightly to ensure readability. The user's face, shown in a small corner window, reacts with genuine awe and relief.
scenes.effects: Hyper-lapse screen recording. The music builds to a climax.
visualEffects: Dynamic text pop-ups: 'Blog Post in 10s!', '5 Ad Variations!', 'Viral Tweet Ideas!', 'INSTANT CONTENT!'

scenes.name: The Result
scenes.description: Cuts to the same person, now looking relaxed and empowered, smiling as they sip coffee. They swipe through their phone, showing a fully scheduled, color-coded content calendar to signify completion and being ahead of schedule. The background is bright and clean.
scenes.effects: Smooth, slow-motion shot. The music becomes confident and rhythmic. A satisfying 'check mark' sound effect is heard as they approve content.

scenes.name: The Call to Action
scenes.description: A full-screen graphic with the Jasper logo. A clear text overlay appears: 'Stop Writing, Start Creating.' followed by 'Get 10,000 words FREE with Jasper ✨ Link in Bio'. A subtle phone UI overlay appears with an animated finger tapping where the bio link would be.
scenes.effects: Clean, bold text animation. An arrow points downwards.
visualEffects: Persistent text 'LINK IN BIO' appears at the bottom for the last 5 seconds.
